$comment: Test placement manifest. Which framework test suites run on which backend, tier and runner class.
.github/scripts/run-tests.sh reads this file; the lane workflows only say which tiers and backends a job covers.
Placement follows section 5.2 of the automation baseline report: a suite runs on the cheapest runner class that
satisfies its requirement. Every suite carries the reason for its tier so the port can be checked line by line.
Tiers: fast (no device), windowed (a window plus a software renderer: xvfb+Mesa on Linux, WARP on Windows),
software-gpu (Mesa llvmpipe / lavapipe; populated by the Phase C measurement pass), hardware (a real GPU or audio
device: self-hosted only), quarantine (known broken; never run, listed so it is not forgotten).
Runner classes: hosted-linux, hosted-linux-arm64, hosted-windows, hosted-macos, selfhosted-windows, selfhosted-macos.
Suite fields: id, tier, backends, reason, and one of test (NUnitLite --test), where (NUnitLite --where) or filter
(dotnet test --filter when runner is dotnet-test); optional runners (allow-list of classes), exclude-runners
(deny-list of classes), skip (os or arch names), timeout (ms, default 300000), labels (NUnitLite --labels).
Backend fields: payload, os (allow-list), skip (arch names). Native backends (desktopgl4, desktopvk) skip arm64
because the Linux test payloads are built on x64 and carry x64 mgruntime only; arm64 payloads need the arm64
native build wired into the test lane (Phase B/C).

suites.reason: Core, maths, content and Game-class unit tests need no device, except GameComponentTest.InitializeOrderTest which creates one. Measured on hosted Windows (run 38567307917): 380/381 pass, the one failure is NoSuitableGraphicsDeviceException because the hosted Windows image has no OpenGL driver beyond 1.1. Excluded there until Phase C provides Mesa llvmpipe (opengl32.dll) for DesktopGL on Windows.
Needs a window and a device context, which xvfb + Mesa and WARP provide. Ran twice per run in main.yml (build job and test job); now once.
Needs a window only. Ran on every test runner in main.yml.

Frame-capture tests that need an OpenGL context. Pass (or are ignored) on hosted Linux with Mesa; on hosted Windows the one live test fails with NoSuitableGraphicsDeviceException (no OpenGL driver on the image). Excluded there until Phase C provides Mesa llvmpipe for DesktopGL on Windows.

Runs a Game loop in a window with an OpenGL context. 46 pass / 13 skipped on hosted Linux. On hosted Windows the process dies with an AccessViolationException (no OpenGL driver on the image), which is why main.yml never ran it there. Excluded until Phase C provides Mesa llvmpipe for DesktopGL on Windows.
